_what: The 123 clusterable Medicare Advantage measure-year(-org) rows of the paper's exact optimality-gap table. Three rows have fewer than five distinct score values and carry k < 5 with k - 1 cut points (none when k = 1). Each row carries its sorted score list after the outlier bounds as exact decimal strings. Checked by stars-evaluate.py.
_source: Score lists built from the parsed CMS score files listed below (sha256 given) by applying the outlier bounds described in the paper; cut points and objective values from runs/exact_gaps_fullsample_docsonly.json, the package's optimality-gap table.

_conventions.sample: sorted scores after the outlier bounds, as decimal strings (exact values)
_conventions.ssq: within-cluster sum of squares, exact rational, Fraction strings
_conventions.stars: higher_is_better: star = 1 + #{cut points <= x}; else star = 5 - #{cut points < x}
_conventions.gap: ward_ssq - dp_ssq (published grouping minus exact optimum)
